engine: A surveyor/draughting metadata frame over a full-bleed stage. Four draughting TICK-CORNERS (crosshair L-brackets) are drawn into place via stroke-dashoffset, then a small all-caps tracked readout reveals staggered: a COORDINATE readout (lat/long), a SCALE BAR (0 ... 500 m), a NORTH arrow, and up to four corner LABELS. reveal() runs the staggered intro once; set(p) is a PURE reversible scrub of the same state. The single highest-demand toBuild atom (17 wanters: hero / menu / amenities / location). Distinct from corner-frame-meta (Saisei editorial caption labels): THIS is the surveyor frame - crosshair ticks + coords + scale + north.

measured_teardown.move: the atom INJECTS its own .ccf-overlay into any target. reveal() (one-shot): (1) the four crosshair tick paths DRAW in via stroke-dashoffset (each path length L: dashoffset L -> 0), small stagger; (2) the readout items (coords, scale bar, north arrow, corner labels) fade (opacity 0->1) + rise (translateY 8->0) staggered, beginning as the ticks finish. set(p 0..1) is the PURE reversible state: tick draw fraction = clamp(p / tick); readout fade/rise = clamp((p - tick*0.5) / (1 - tick*0.5)) sliced per-item by stagger. hide() resets all. owns_pin false (triggered or scrubbed, never pins).
measured_teardown.cited: Surveyor/draughting frame: crosshair tick-corners + lat/long coordinate readout + scale bar + north arrow in small all-caps tracked type - a measured architectural plate, not a photo.

coords.what: the lat/long coordinate readout (bottom-centre, with an accent dot). Use REAL coordinates of the site.

scale.what: the scale-bar caption (bottom-left, above the bl tick; survey ticks above it). Use a REAL scale.

north.what: draw the north needle (top-right, under the tr tick). false = omit.

labels.what: optional corner labels { tl, bl, br, rc } - small all-caps tracked text tucked beside each tick (rc is vertical, right-centre).

ease.what: reveal ease token: air (power3.out / cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)), soft, expo, none.

stagger.what: delay between successive readout items revealing.

dur.what: duration of the tick draw and of each readout item's fade+rise.

tick.what: fraction of set(p)'s progress over which the tick-corners finish drawing (the readout fills the rest).

size.what: arm length of each crosshair tick-corner (the L-bracket).

inset.what: distance of the frame (ticks + readout) from the stage edges.

css_vars.--ccf-mono: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace - the tracked mono face

entry: CoordsCornerFrame.create(target, opts) -> { reveal(), set(p), hide(), destroy }. target = ANY stage element (the atom injects its own .ccf-overlay). reveal() runs the staggered intro once; set(p 0..1) is a PURE reversible scrub; hide() resets.
law: transform (translateY) + opacity (the readout) + stroke-dashoffset (the tick draw) only; GPU; NO width/height/top/left animation; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop / NO WebGL / NO canvas. will-change cleared after the one-shot. reduced-motion -> everything shown statically (.ccf-static). owns_pin false. GSAP optional (CSS-transition fallback when absent).
gate_mode: triggered (reveal once) or scrubbed (set(p)) - NOT scroll-pinned, the wheel gate doesn't apply. Verify: the four crosshair tick-corners draw into the corners (stroke-dashoffset), then the lat/long readout, the scale bar, the north arrow and the corner labels fade+rise in staggered; set(p) reverses the whole state smoothly. Distinct from corner-frame-meta (editorial caption labels, pure fade - this is the surveyor frame: ticks + coords + scale + north).
proven: lab: over a dark map field with a faint road sketch built from the REAL Агрономічне OSM (135 roads in the window + the real projected site + 6 real POIs), with a TRUE lat/long (49.18N 28.33E) and a 500 m scale bar. reveal() draws the four crosshair ticks then staggers the coords / scale / north / labels in; set(p) scrubbed reverses the state. transform + opacity + stroke-dashoffset only; will-change cleared on complete. Zero console errors; __LAB_OK__ true (wired AND field painted). Mono stand-in = IBM Plex Mono.
